integrity: The claim is limited to the proved alternating endpoint identity. No finite experiment is presented as an infinite proof, no unavailable source is treated as inspected in full, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is stated for integer r>=1 and does not cover the r=0 boundary datum, derive new congruences, or classify every singular limit of the parameterized source identity. Exact-rational computation is corroborative only; the universal result rests on the symbolic telescoping proof. Possible overlap with inaccessible full text of arXiv:2608.13192v1 remains a literature risk.
title: Alternating endpoint identity at the singular weight \(x=-1\)
